title: Fix Admin Panel error when accessing /admin route

requirements.text: Debug and resolve the error occurring when navigating to /admin route. Investigate the AdminGuard component's authentication flow, ensure proper Internet Identity integration, and verify the admin credentials validation against the backend actor.

quotes: I am facing the problem of an Error occurred on Admin Panel when I am Searching By /admin

acceptanceCriteria: Login with ID: 97SKY80 and password: SKY8084 works successfully
Admin panel displays after successful authentication

requirements.text: Add error boundary or error handling to the AdminPage component to catch and display specific error messages instead of generic error states, helping identify the root cause of authentication or routing failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Clear error messages are displayed when authentication fails
Error boundary prevents entire app crash if AdminPage encounters errors
Console logs provide debugging information for troubleshooting

requirements.text: Verify that the backend actor's verifyAdmin method is properly accessible and returns expected responses when called with the correct admin credentials (ID: 97SKY80, password: SKY8084).
acceptanceCriteria: verifyAdmin method accepts the correct admin ID and password
Method returns true for valid credentials and false for invalid ones
No backend errors are thrown during admin verification

constraints: Preserve existing admin credentials (ID: 97SKY80, password: SKY8084)
Do not modify the Internet Identity integration hooks (useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts)
nonGoals: Adding new admin features or functionality
